name: Commons
summary: Travelers and traders crowd the Commons, just inside Ironforge's gates. The district links the entrance to the mountain city's great caverns and draws merchants, travelers, and bankers from across the Alliance.

sections.title: The Commercial Hub of the Mountain
sections.body: The Commons greets you just northeast of the Gates of Ironforge. Carved from the mountain stone, its market street holds the Alliance Auction House, Stonefire Tavern, and the city's central bank in the Vault of Ironforge. Broad roads lead from here to the Great Forge, the Mystic Ward, and the Military Ward. Nearly everyone crossing the mountain city passes its shops.

sections.title: A Crossroads for the Alliance
sections.body: The Commons draws trade from across the Eastern Kingdoms. Ironforge's central position and the underground Deeprun Tram link to Stormwind bring travelers and merchants here. Adventurers trade goods from across Azeroth, buy weapons at Steelfury's Weapon Emporium, or purchase reagents from Barim. Some meet beneath the inn's warm lanterns before setting out into the snows of Khaz Modan.

faq.q: What makes the Commons so crowded compared to other districts?
faq.answer: The Commons is crowded because it holds the Alliance Auction House, Ironforge's main bank in the Vault of Ironforge, and Stonefire Tavern. Just inside the main gates, it is a convenient place to meet and trade.
The Commons leads to nearly every major district in Ironforge. Southwest takes you back to the city gates, northeast to the Great Forge, east toward the Military Ward, and north into the Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What key shops and services are found here?
faq.answer: The Commons has the Auction House and bank, along with the Ironforge Visitor's Center, Steelfury's Weapon Emporium, the Ironforge Armory, Barim's Reagents, and Fizzlespinner's General Goods.
Yes. The Vault of Ironforge, the city's main bank, is across from the Auction House in the Commons.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the Commons is a busy place to trade. Heroes from Teldrassil, Stormwind, and Gnomeregan come to auction valuable spoils and gather supplies.
As a Bronzebeard dwarf, the Commons shows how dwarven hospitality, industry, and commerce thrive deep within a frozen mountain.
